title: Hosted public leaderboard with held-out test
context: After the benchmark is released and the scoring harness is operational, a hosted public leaderboard allows external groups to submit results and see how they compare. The leaderboard must enforce the honest-reporting schema (split ID, seeds, variance, preprocessing hash, compute provenance required on every submission) and must not expose held-out test labels. This is a large, future-backlog task gated on a steward providing hosting infrastructure. The benchmark explicitly does not chase a single headline number; the leaderboard must surface honest, variance-reported metrics rather than gaming incentives. Depends on steward hosting. See PLAN.md (non-goals: not a leaderboard chasing a single number).
objective: Design and implement a hosted public leaderboard interface for the benchmark: accept predictions from external submitters, score them via the evaluation harness from pathology-image-benchmarks-harness-001, display results (with required provenance metadata: split ID, seeds, variance, preprocessing hash), and enforce the honest-reporting schema on every submission. Must not expose held-out test labels. Requires steward-provided hosting infrastructure.
acceptanceCriteria: The leaderboard accepts prediction files in the defined submission format and scores them via the evaluation harness (pathology-image-benchmarks-harness-001).
The honest-reporting schema is enforced: submissions missing split ID, seeds, preprocessing hash, or compute provenance are rejected, not silently accepted.
Held-out ground-truth labels are not accessible to submitters through the leaderboard interface.
The leaderboard displays per-submission metrics with variance/seed information, not just a single headline number.
Hosting infrastructure is documented (steward-provided); the code is portable and not vendor-locked.
The leaderboard code is implemented as a PR; deployment is gated on the steward confirming hosting is available.
The 'not for clinical or diagnostic use; research only' notice is displayed prominently on the leaderboard.
output: A hosted public leaderboard implementation PR with honest-reporting enforcement, held-out label protection, and variance-reporting display; gated on steward hosting confirmation.
